import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")


def bump_version(version: str) -> None:
    print(f"Bumping version to {version} in {VERSION_FILE}...")
    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
    VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)


def prepare_release_notes(version: str) -> None:
    print(f"Preparing release notes for {version} in {RELEASE_NOTES_FILE}...")
    content = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.read_text()

    # Find the "## Latest Changes" section
    latest_changes_marker = "## Latest Changes"
    start_pos = content.find(latest_changes_marker)
    if start_pos == -1:
        print("Could not find '## Latest Changes' in release notes.")
        return

    # Find the end of the "Latest Changes" section (next "## " header)
    end_pos = content.find("\n## ", start_pos + len(latest_changes_marker))

    if end_pos == -1:
        # Section goes to the end of the file
        latest_changes_content = content[start_pos + len(latest_changes_marker):].strip()
        rest_of_file = ""
    else:
        latest_changes_content = content[start_pos + len(latest_changes_marker):end_pos].strip()
        rest_of_file = content[end_pos:]

    # Create the new version section

    # Reconstruct the file:
    # 1. Everything before "## Latest Changes"
    # 2. "## Latest Changes" header
    # 3. The new version section
    # 4. The rest of the file
